lines.english: "Hang on a second… what's going on here?"
"I can't believe they got the audience so fired up. The singer and the guitarist are both such obvious amateurs."
"We started practicing months ago. I can't accept losing to a group like this!"
"Chiaki… No matter what anyone says, you're the star here today, okay?"
"Don't talk to me right now. I'm basking in the afterglow."
"As I thought, the audience is much bigger in the afternoon. It would've been nice if we had gotten to go last…"
"Hey, hey, forget about that for now. Look, isn't that person cute?"
"You're telling others not to talk to you, but now you want to talk…"
"Isn't it cheating to have Ogiso as the singer?"
"None of the boys are even listening to the song. They're just here to gawk at Ogiso-san."
"No, not the singer, the guitarist. The way he looks uncertain about which girl he wants to impress."
